eips.name: ETH transfers emit a log
eips.notes: Used for native ETH transfer visibility checks. Status refreshed from EIP-7773.

eips.name: Enshrined Proposer-Builder Separation
eips.notes: Used for validator and operator readiness checks around builder/API metadata.

eips.name: Block Gas Accounting without Refunds
eips.notes: Scheduled by EIP-7773. No detector currently claims exact refund or gas accounting behavior.

eips.name: SLOTNUM opcode
eips.notes: Scheduled by EIP-7773. No detector currently inspects SLOTNUM-specific bytecode behavior.

eips.name: Block-Level Access Lists
eips.notes: Used for BAL-related indexer and monitoring readiness checks. Do not hardcode final behavior in detector code.

eips.name: Increase Maximum Contract Size
eips.notes: Used only to flag contract-size review areas. Final limits may change.

eips.name: Increase Calldata Floor Cost
eips.notes: Used for calldata-heavy trace and bytecode review prompts when calldata evidence is visible.

eips.name: Increase Access List Cost
eips.notes: Scheduled by EIP-7773. No detector currently infers exact access-list cost impact.

eips.name: Backward compatible SWAPN, DUPN, EXCHANGE
eips.notes: Scheduled by EIP-7773. No detector currently scans for these opcodes.

eips.name: State Creation Gas Cost Increase
eips.notes: Used for CREATE and CREATE2 review prompts. Do not infer exact cost changes.

eips.name: Reduce intrinsic transaction gas
eips.notes: Considered by EIP-7773. No detector currently infers native transfer fee changes.

eips.name: Forward compatible consensus data structures
eips.notes: Considered by EIP-7773. Tracked for operator awareness only.

eips.name: General Repricing
eips.notes: Broad repricing candidate. Exact gas deltas must come from data, not hardcoded detector logic.

eips.name: Deterministic Factory Predeploy
eips.notes: Considered by EIP-7773. No detector currently infers app behavior from deterministic factory assumptions.

eips.name: State-access gas cost increase
eips.notes: Used for storage/account access review prompts. Do not infer exact cost changes.

eips.name: Exclude slashed validators from proposing
eips.notes: Considered by EIP-7773. Tracked for validator/operator readiness context.

eips.name: Increase exit and consolidation churn
eips.notes: Considered by EIP-7773 and present in the glamsterdam-devnet-2 spec as a new EIP.

eips.name: Let exits use the consolidation queue
eips.notes: Considered by EIP-7773. EF Soldogn recap says CL teams discussed and narrowed smaller Glamsterdam EIPs.

eips.name: Remove SELFDESTRUCT Burn
eips.notes: Considered by EIP-7773. No detector currently scans SELFDESTRUCT burn semantics.

eips.name: eth/70 - partial block receipt lists
eips.notes: Networking EIP considered by EIP-7773. Tracked for indexer and sync-tool awareness.

eips.name: Cell-Level Deltas for Data Column Broadcast
eth/71 - Block Access List Exchange
eips.notes: Networking companion to EIP-7928. Tracked for tooling that retrieves BALs from peers.

eips.name: Max blob flag for local builders
Meter Contract Code Size And Increase Limit
Call and Return Opcodes for the EVM
eips.notes: Listed as proposed for inclusion by EIP-7773, despite also appearing in the declined section.

eips.name: Static relative jumps and calls for the EVM
Gas Units Rebase for High-precision Metering
Add sweep withdrawal fee for 0x01 validators
Revert creation in case of non-empty storage
Glamsterdam gas repricing candidates
eips.notes: Umbrella entry for broad heuristics until exact final parameters are confirmed.
